# Fermium Designs

> Expert fitout approvals in Dubai for construction, renovation, and modification projects. Get fast authority permits & approvals in Dubai. DM, DCD, DDA, & more.

Fermium Designs is a Dubai-based project management company specialising in fitout approvals, authority permits, and structural design services. We handle the full approvals process with Dubai Municipality (DM), Dubai Civil Defence (DCD), Dubai Development Authority (DDA), DEWA, Nakheel, DAMAC, Jafza, and other authorities.

## Services

- [Fitout Approvals](https://www.fermiumdesigns.ae/services/approvals)
- [Structural Design & Engineering](https://www.fermiumdesigns.ae/services/structural)
- [Authority Permits & NOCs](https://www.fermiumdesigns.ae/services/approvals)
- [Project Management](https://www.fermiumdesigns.ae)
